titulo: Search, minimum and maximum in a BST
enunciado: In the BST of 8, 3, 10, 1, 6, 14, 4, 7, 13 search for 7 and 5 showing the path followed, and find the minimum and maximum by going only left or only right.
objetivos: Search a BST discarding a subtree at each step
pistas: Compare with the root and go down one side only.
The minimum is the leftmost node.
The cost is proportional to the height, not to the number of nodes.
